paragraphs.text: Lander is a predefined token introduced in Edge of Eternities . It represents small shuttle spacecraft designed to land on the surface of a planet . Landers accelerate mana production by tutoring for a basic land from the library onto the battlefield.
Lander tokens have " , , Sacrifice this token: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle." They are most prominent in green and red.

The cost of activation and card regained is reminiscent of Clue s, but the payoff being a land gives it a texture akin to Treasure : it has diminishing returns when spells run dry. As such, they incentivize being sacrificed early, costing some tempo, to encourage bigger endgames, like the big creatures and Spacecraft of Edge of Eternities . They also work well to aid the landfall , sacrifice and void mechanics of the set.
As a white compensation effect, Emergency Eject gives a Lander token to your opponent.
Future sets can use Lander tokens if they make sense, though the name is a bit restrictive.
